description_en: Build, run, and manage agent platforms.
readme_excerpt: Build, run, and manage agent platforms. Introduction Agno is a framework and runtime for agent platforms. Build agents, run them as a service, manage your platform using a web UI. - Build your agent platform using the Agno SDK. - Run your agent platform using the AgentOS runtime. - Manage everything using the AgentOS UI.
